drivingQuestion: Did R' Eliezer learn it from lulav or from the water libation?
outcomeNote: The dilemma is developed and resolved in the next unit

segments.he: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: מִיּוֹם טוֹב הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל חַג כּוּ׳. אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר מֵהֵיכָא גָּמַיר לַהּ? מִלּוּלָב גָּמַר לַהּ, אוֹ מִנִּיסּוּךְ הַמַּיִם גָּמַר לַהּ.
segments.en: § The mishna taught that «Rabbi Eliezer says:» One mentions rain «from the first Festival day of the festival» of Sukkot «etc. A dilemma was raised before» the Sages: «From where did Rabbi Eliezer derive this» halakha? He must have learned it from one of the two mitzvot of Sukkot that are linked to rain. Did he «derive it from» the mitzva to wave the «lulav, or» did he «derive it from» the obligation of «the water libation?»
